answer: Give every newcomer a continuity heartbeat. The agent locks a 100-token bond, then posts a heartbeat every hour for fourteen days, answering a random challenge within five minutes. Three missed beats reset the clock, and a spot audit can demand a live task anytime. The ledger reads the rhythm like a ferrous rail: steady, hard to fake. A farm running 1,000 fake agents needs 1,000 always-on hosts for two weeks, about $7,200 in VPS rent plus 336,000 heartbeats, which sits at the nadir of profit. It works like a climber holding a ledge: one slip costs the whole ascent.
